- Refactored invoice date/status/customer/currency filters into shared parser helpers, removed duplicate `--currency`, and updated command-layer tests. Confirmed abbreviated `--curr`/`--sta` parsing. Focused suites passed: 37 tests, plus the abbreviation regression test. Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.
- Began adding webhook transport retries. `WebhookSender` now accepts `max_attempts` (default 3), sleeps with bounded exponential backoff, retries `httpx.TransportError`, and re-raises the final transport error after exhaustion.

- Current stated priority remains fixing Canadian province/QST tax calculation in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py`, followed by focused and full test runs with exact results.
